blocks.text: READ: Follow Inquirer Sports’ special coverage of the Aichi-Nagoya Asian Games 2026 MANILA, Philippines–Team Philippines’ Mazel Paris and Jericho Francisco advanced to the park skateboarding finals of the Asian Games 2026 after finishing fourth overall in their respective preliminaries Thursday at Aichi Sky Expo. Paris, 12, scored 73.93 points in Heat 2 to finish fourth overall in the women’s event. Japan’s Mizuho Hasegawa topped the heat with 89.15 points. “It was super fun. I landed my runs, and that was my goal,” Paris said. “For tomorrow, I’m gonna pray to land my runs and to have fun.” Francisco also placed fourth […]...
